tasks.old_behavior: The action_s struct had pszName as its last field before DEF_ATOMIC_HELPER_MUT(mutCAS), followed by error file fields and then stats counters ending at ctrResume.
tasks.new_behavior: The action_s struct has two new fields (pszRatelimitName, ratelimiter) inserted after pszName, and 4 new STATSCOUNTER_DEF fields (ctrRateLimitAllowed, ctrRateLimitDropped, ctrRateLimitPaced, ctrRateLimitPacedUsec) added after ctrResume. The ratelimit_shared_s struct has 3 new fields (scope, output_mode, output_pace_forbidden) inserted before interval, shifting all subsequent field offsets.
tasks.compatibility_reason: The action_s and ratelimit_shared_s structs are declared in public headers (action.h, ratelimit.h). Any code compiled against the old struct layouts that directly accesses struct members, uses sizeof(), or relies on field offsets will read incorrect data. Even indirect consumers (e.g., debuggers, core dump analyzers, serialization code) may be affected.
tasks.test_recommendation: Rebuild all modules against the new headers and run full test suite. Verify ABI compatibility through symbol versioning checks if available.
